name: upload
title: Entity: Upload
description: Upload metadata entity used by draft galleries and listing galleries after direct bucket upload.
text:
# Upload

TL;DR:
- Upload is the application metadata record for one already uploaded file.
- Upload ids are what galleries and publish flows reference, not raw CDN URLs.

What it is:
- An upload is a registered file record that points to a CDN URL and has a stable upload id.

What it is used for:
- Draft galleries and listing galleries reference upload ids to build ordered image sets.

Relationships:
- upload <- created after user.uploadCreate
- gallery -> upload
- draft gallery -> upload
- listing gallery -> upload

Agent hint:
- Preserve upload.id. It is the thing later tools need. Do not confuse it with the raw CDN URL or pre-signed PUT URL.
